# 主題一：自主調查與採樣

本輪由 Codex 使用內建 imagegen 直接製作。主視覺是一組分離的環境剖面展品，並非四個案例發生在同一處。深色背景、右側主體、左側標題留白，底部預留四個案例入口。

預定專案原檔：`outputs/ecology-ai-rollout-assets/topic-01/topic-01-main-v01.png`。
網頁衍生檔：`outputs/ecology-ai-site-v01/assets/topic-01-main-v01.webp`。

## 生成提示詞

```text
Create one sophisticated editorial concept illustration for a full-screen science website hero about autonomous ecological field observation and sampling. Landscape 16:9 composition, high detail, no text.

Art direction: a beautifully crafted natural-history exhibition made from SEPARATE organic landscape cutaway specimens, assembled into one asymmetrical still life against a very dark ink-green background. This is clearly a conceptual exhibit, not a photograph of one real location. Use convincing natural material textures and soft directional studio light. The finish is mature and tactile, between a museum diorama and a finely rendered scientific illustration. Avoid plastic toy styling, low-poly game scenery and futuristic glowing technology.

Composition: the entire exhibit occupies the right 55–60% of the frame, concentrated between x=47–94%, y=13–76%. Leave the left 40–42% quiet, nearly uniform dark ink-green for a large light-coloured Chinese headline that will be added in HTML. Keep the bottom 17% dark and visually quiet for four navigation links. No object touches the right edge. Preserve room around important subjects so mobile cropping can retain the main group.

The exhibit has four distinguishable, visually separated specimens with varied sizes and heights, not four equal cards or quadrants:
1. The front-right main specimen is an organic slice of deep ocean water, with a subtle surface and a clearly readable, fully submerged sperm whale. Give the whale its distinctive large blunt head and tapering body. Show the full animal, softly attenuated by blue water. The slice has a naturally irregular edge and a dark geological base; it is not a glass aquarium or a transparent rectangular cube.
2. Behind and slightly left of it, a smaller dry grassland specimen carries two clearly recognizable zebras and a tiny, restrained quadcopter silhouette above them. Keep the landscape fragment separate from the ocean with a dark gap, not a shared coastline. The zebras are natural in proportion, with legible striped bodies.
3. A separate smaller blue-green water specimen behind the main ocean slice contains two modest torpedo-shaped underwater research vehicles. No beams, trails or emitted sonar. Near that specimen, a few delicate translucent green microalgal cell models are displayed as an enlarged museum specimen, visibly a separate illustrative layer rather than giant cells living in the water beside the vehicles.
4. At the far right, a smaller night-field specimen shows a single moth resting on a partial upright off-white imaging board, with subdued vegetation around it. The moth should be visible as a moth. The small board is softly lit, never an overexposed giant white rectangle. Suggest an observation station without inventing detailed instrument controls or wiring.

Make the four parts feel like one curated exhibit through consistent lighting, scale hierarchy, dark bases and restrained material colours. Their visible gaps, separate cut edges and different display heights must clearly distinguish their environments. Do not connect them with a continuous horizon, road, coastline, pipe or flight route. This is not a real shared expedition, ecological map, literal size comparison or engineering schematic.

Palette: very dark forest green and charcoal ground, deep marine blue, muted grassy olive, subtle warm natural light, restrained ivory. The main ocean and sperm whale hold the eye; the other specimens enrich the scene without turning into visual noise. Natural shadows, fine fur/scale/grass/water detail, clean silhouette edges, no decorative particles.

Do not render a website, title, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, logo, border, chart, bounding boxes, arrows, grids, radar rings, sonar cones, neon outlines, glowing paths or data overlays. Do not show people. Do not use square blocks, isometric icon tiles, a gaming map or four pasted photographs. The website will add the short caption '跨案例概念插畫，非共同研究現場' outside the image; do not bake any caption into the art.
```
